header.title: Papyrus Boulaq 3 (Theben West): AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Late funerary papyri
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:egy:tla:bbawtotenlit:papyrus-boulaq-3-theben-west:translit, from the Thesaurus Linguae Aegyptiae (2018), in Simon Schweitzer's AED-TEI (CC BY-SA 4.0), one English line for each line of the original. nodes.text: May your ba unite with Imhotep while you are within the valley, your heart glad.
